release_notes:
• Dual notification actions: Disconnect and Skip Server directly from status bar
• Real-time notification stats: Server name, live speeds, total data, and remaining time
• Low-time alert notification (< 5 minutes left) with one-tap recharge
• 5-Tier Priority Queue with real HTTP TTFB and Stability Index
• Dead Man's Switch: Silent ACK blackhole freeze detector & auto-recovery
• Fake-IP zero-delay DNS engine in Sing-box (0ms client DNS resolution)
• Deep Sleep Battery Saver when device is locked/backgrounded
• Gaming Mode low-jitter filtering
• Fix Next Server reconnecting to previous server
